$comment: S18 Geofabrik OSM extracts (T022). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s18.yaml. Input is the owner's browser-downloaded Southern Zone PBF (D34, D174).

fields.name: osm_type
fields.meaning: node or way; relations are not used

fields.name: feature_kind
fields.meaning: hospital, clinic, police, fire_station, shelter, assembly_point, bus_stop or road

fields.name: tags_json
fields.meaning: all OSM tags as sorted JSON, unchanged

valid_at: null: an extract is the map state at its replication timestamp, not a dated observation
clip: rows whose centroid lies in the state polygon (S17); objects with an unresolved node are skipped and counted
not_included: shelter opening status, capacity or operation: OSM does not state them and none are inferred
